versions.summary: The first FMTS schema (FB-135), restored unchanged from the repository's history. No spec is written against it; it was replaced in place by 0.2.0 before any spec was approved.

Baseline at the start of the schema registry (FB-151). 0.2.0 added module_identity.alias; before the registry it was also edited in place for the module kinds (FB-150). At the baseline every schema took the one id form forge://fxts/<framework>/v<version> and gained integrity.schema_version and integrity.schema_hash.
FB-165: the transport contract's requirements M-12 to M-16, the transport section, and not_applicable for M-15 and M-16 (D-12 amendment, owner 2026-11-19)

FB-153: module_identity.function, the integration section, and in transport the data classes, the store-and-forward capacity with its pruning strategies, the last will and an optional tighter keepalive (owner, 2026-11-19); values come from governed lists
